title: Resent
summary: RESENT', verb transitive s as z. [Latin sentio.] 1. To take well; to receive with satisfaction. obsolete 2. To take ill; to consider as an injury or affront; to be in some degree angry or provoked at.

inlines.v: RESENT', verb transitive s as z. [Latin sentio.] 1. To take well; to receive with satisfaction. obsolete 2. To take ill; to consider as an injury or affront; to be in some degree angry or provoked at. Thou with scorn and anger would'st resent the offer'd wrong.
